title: Five Places to Go in Nashville
abstract: Nashville’s Wedgewood-Houston neighborhood was long a run-down part of town. After creative types moved into the area, trendy restaurants, galleries, distilleries and other business have followed.

title: Five Places to Shop in Belfast
abstract: Belfast’s lively city center is a compact pedestrian-friendly area where the shopping gems are independently owned establishments.

title: Five Places to Go in Chicago
abstract: Chicago’s storied Uptown neighborhood has emerged from a decades-long slump with new restaurants and cultural centers.
